description: This file defines structures, constants, and function prototypes for command-line argument parsing, specifically for getopt and getopt_long functionalities, within the Zephyr RTOS environment.

methods.name: getopt_init
methods.description: Initializes the getopt_state structure for the current thread.

methods.name: getopt_state_get
methods.description: Returns the getopt_state structure for the current thread.

methods.name: getopt_long
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments, supporting long options with '--'.

methods.name: getopt_long_only
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments, allowing '-' or '--' for long options.
